summary:
I ran a full census on a byte copy of HEAD f7ac37d. The repo is untouched (git status still shows only docs.rar), and every Lune process was my own, at most 3 at a time. Each design was moved whole along X, Y or Z alone, 21 ways in all: ±0.0013, ±0.037, ±0.3317 where the hitbox allows, and each design's own room less 0.001. That ran on all 136 Parity fixtures, Parity's 200 generated designs and all 33,389 plausible designs, and each shifted analysis was compared in-process with the unshifted one.

**Tree, plausible set.** Along Z, G moves on up to 5,125 designs; 698 move past 0.002, 22 play another tier, max 0.0472 (laminates). A shift of only 0.0013 already moves G on 3,978 designs, with 22 tier changes. Along Y, G moves on up to 547 designs (135 past 0.002, 2 tiers, max 0.0363), and Joints moves on up to 2,527. Along X, Asymmetry and the edge move because the SPEC anchors them at x = 0; beyond those two, G still moves on up to 6,041 designs (115 past 0.002, 15 tiers, max 0.0666).

**Tree, fixtures and generated.** On the fixtures, a Z shift changes which of the near-copies X01/X02 counts as visible. An X nudge of 0.0013 plays P5's Hammering at Normal instead of Hard (0.2167 → 0.1902). The generated designs move nothing along Y or Z beyond last-bit rounding. Validity never changes except when a design leaves the hitbox.

**Causes.** Scratch variants that each switch one cause off account for every move:
- The verdict and measure ranks key on |x| and |z|, so a shift reorders equal parts. This causes every Z and every X tier change and the large moves.
- M2's ownership box test uses margin 0 while GJK, which it feeds, uses 1e-9. At an exact face contact, rounding decides whether the touching part is counted as above. The effect spreads through the global overlap ladder and through Asymmetry's ladder. This causes almost all Y moves.
- M2's cell counts flip when an extent is an exact whole number of cells, and when a touching part's box is flat (0 cells or 4).
- GJK's tangency on round parts is accurate only to about 4e-8, while OVERLAP_TOL is 1e-9.
- Asymmetry's mirror-candidate box test sits at exactly reach (0.05).
- Contact at exactly CONTACT_TOL changes Joints only.
- G's 1e-4 rounding is tipped by the last bits of a factor.

Normalising the design's position leaves the laminate tier changes, because rounding then breaks their exact ties. Keying the ranks on z alone fixes Z but breaks mirror symmetry.

**Recommended fix R: six local guards.**
1. Key both ranks on each part's quantised distance from the sword's own grip centre (RANK_Q 1e-9).
2. Make the ownership box test use OVERLAP_TOL, and raise OVERLAP_TOL to 1e-7.
3. Make the overlap cell counts tolerate rounding.
4. Widen Asymmetry's candidate box by 1e-9.
5. Round each factor to 1e-9 inside G's sum.
6. Treat contact as CONTACT_TOL + 1e-9.

**Result with R.** On all 33,389 + 136 + 200 designs and all 21 shifts, nothing moves beyond last-bit rounding. G does not move on any design along Y or Z, and along X nothing moves but the x = 0 reads. The only exception is the invalid fixture A22c: it has no kept Grip part, so its reach and guard position are measured from the world origin.

**R's cost.**
- **Speed:** within noise.
- **Mirror images:** read as before.
- **Fixtures and generated designs:** read bit for bit, except Joints on 11 fixtures. That one change comes from the contact guard and is what moves the T-DIF-12 goldens and the fixtures digest.
- **Plausible designs:** G moves on 703 as built (max 0.0354; 2 grilles change tier).

R without the contact guard keeps the digest and the goldens, but leaves Joints moving under shifts. Joints is unweighted in the MVP.
findings: Moves a player can make (SPEC): Ctrl+A selects all visible parts (§11.6, SPEC.md:2966). Move drag, nudge and typed position move the selection; snapping is the player's choice and free drags give any double (§11.6–11.8, SPEC.md:2962–3041). Ctrl+I moves the selection into the hitbox. 'Centre on axis' puts the selection's extents on x = 0 (§11.10, SPEC.md:3075). No storage grid (§3.5, SPEC.md:637–667). So a whole-design move along X, Y or Z inside the hitbox is a player move.

Where those moves show: the origin is the hitbox's bottom-face centre, and x = 0 and z = 0 are its centre and mirror planes (§3.1, SPEC.md:514–516). In the game an item renders anchored on its own bounds, BaseCenter = (cx, minY, cz) or Center (§13.7, SPEC.md:3549), so a whole-design move is invisible there on all three axes. In the analysis only x = 0 means anything, and by SPEC design: Asymmetry is about the fixed plane x = 0 (§5.2, SPEC.md:1442; anti-gaming row SPEC.md:1547), and the edge raster's x starts at x = 0 (Edge.luau:20–22, 361–364, 419–420). Nothing reads z = 0 (thickness asymmetry is not measured, §5.2), and nothing reads y = 0 except containment.

Rank mechanism, code: the verdict's rank Sampling.ranked keys {−v, cy, |cx|, cx, |cz|, cz, h1, h2, h3} after the slot name (Sampling.luau:505). The measure's rank Sampling.measureRanked keys {−volume, cy, |cx|, cx, |cz|, cz, …} (Sampling.luau:551–552). |·| is there for mirror invariance (comment at 482–485), but it is not monotone under a shift, so an X or Z move reorders parts of one volume and y.

What the rank order decides: the verdict's exact copies and coincident faces (Sampling.luau:594–603, 746); the measure's shared faces (614, 645); who spends the sub-grid budget N_SUB_WORK first (605, 661, loop 807); overlap ownership within a slot, and so the size of each part's higher-part set H and whether its overlap is clipped exactly or sampled (MassProps.luau:344–355, 390); Thinness' walk and probe allocation (Factors.luau:347, 530, 539); union-chord ties (Factors.luau:207–208); and the edge walk (Analyze.luau:445).

Rank mechanism, measured on the movers of designs 1–22,260. Ranks by z alone (vz): every Z tier change goes (33 pairs on 11 designs → 0) and max ΔG drops 0.0472 → 0.0175; the rest is ownership. Ranks by x alone (vx): X non-anchored ΔG drops 0.0666 → 0.0009, moves past 0.002 go 79 → 0, tier changes 3 → 0. Fixtures: P5's Thinness 0.0662 under x−0.0013, a tier (vx removes it); X01/X01raw/X02 change kept flags under Z through the verdict's |z| key.

Pairwise impossibility: a key comparing two parts by z alone that is both shift-invariant and mirror-invariant must be f(z1 − z2) with f even, so f(a, b) = f(b, a) and it cannot order the pair. Shift and mirror invariance together therefore need a design reference that moves and mirrors with the design. Exact ties (symmetric pairs) also need quantising: unquantised, a shifted reference breaks them by rounding. Measured: normalising (vnyz) still plays 11 laminates at another tier under Z.

Ownership box test (M2): MassProps.ownership tests aabbOverlap(p, q, 0) (MassProps.luau:368; inclusive, Shapes.luau:276–279), then Gjk.within(p, q, OVERLAP_TOL = 1e-9) (MassProps.luau:78, 370), which counts touching parts (Gjk.luau:183–218). At an exact face contact, rounding decides whether the box test lets the touching part through to GJK.

Grille #32977 example: Guard bars at z 0.04 ± 0.03 sit on Blade part 8 at z 0 ± 0.01. As built, 0.04 − 0.03 = 0.010000000000000002 > 0.01, so part 8 is excluded. Moved −0.037 the boxes meet, part 8 joins H, the jobs' boxes and work grow, and the global hOverlap (MassProps.luau:402–421, N_OVERLAP_WORK) goes 0.05 → 0.0625. Bars 9–11 then own 0.00729 → 0.00245 each (exact 0.00762); M2's volume 0.4406 → 0.4239. Excluding touching parts robustly (vo) takes Y's G moves from 610 pairs (max 0.0085) to 21 (0.0001) on the movers, and Asymmetry under Y from 243 to 0.

Cell counts (M2): cellsPerAxis = ceil(extent/h) (MassProps.luau:284–290). At an exact whole number of cells it flips: C09 at zL+ reads e/h = 11.999999999999998 as built and 12.000000000000002 moved, so 12 → 13 cells. A touching part's flat box gives 0 cells as built (extent 0) and 4 cells when moved (extent 3.6e-15): #8141, hOverlap 0.0125 → 0.015625. Both feed the global ladder. ceil(e/h − 1e-9) alone (vk) cuts owned-volume moves from 6,461 to 335 pairs along X and from 3,912 to 198 along Z on the movers.

GJK tangency: Gjk.luau's own header says round pairs can stop about 4e-8 above the true gap. With OVERLAP_TOL = 1e-9, a part tangent to a Cylinder or Ball is in H or not depending on GJK's convergence. #16913 (a rod Cylinder in a guard), z−0.0013: H {6} → {6, 3}, box x [−0.035, 0.035] → [−0.36, 0.36], G 0.0005. Cages #32730–32733: owned volume of a cleaned caged Ball moves, no G. OVERLAP_TOL 1e-7 closes both.

Asymmetry's ladder: the work estimate is Σ min(n, N_MAX_PART)·(1 + #mirrors + #aboves) (Factors.luau:637), and aboves comes from ownership's H, so H flips feed it (#30009 zL+: spacing 0.0625 → 0.075, Sharpening Asymmetry 0.0134 → 0). Mirror candidates come from a box test at exactly reach = ASYM_TOL + ASYM_RAMP = 0.05 (Factors.luau:611–612). wrapRings with gap 0.0500 (#4493, #4506, #4519, #19295, #19347, #19360) move Asymmetry by 0.003–0.007 and G by up to 0.0037 under Y.

Contact at exactly CONTACT_TOL: the V3 contact graph (Analyze.luau:201–202) and the measure's contact rows (Sampling.luau:630, 638) decide gaps of exactly 0.01 by rounding. Joints is unweighted in the MVP (§5.3) and moves on up to 2,527 plausible designs under y+0.0013 (ΔJ up to 1.58), and on fixtures C04, C05, C07 and C08. G never moves through it, and validity never moved in the census.

G's rounding to 1e-4: g = q(Σ w·x) (Difficulty.luau:110–117). The last bits of a factor (Volume/SC 4e-16) can tip a half-step. With the rank, ownership and contact fixes in, that is the whole residual: 23 pairs on 13 designs in designs 1–22,260, each a G change of exactly 0.0001 (plateEdge yL+, laminate z).

Frame fallback: with no kept Grip part, the frame point is the world origin (MassProps.luau:509–518). A22c (Adversarial, invalid, measured only with measureInvalid) therefore reads reach, guardPos and balanceFromHand from the origin under every shift. G is not affected; this fixture is the only residual of the final fix.

x = 0 anchors, by SPEC: an X nudge of 0.0013 moves the x-anchored raster's cell boundaries and can change the edge's chain count. Worst valid 8 at x+0.0013: chains 2 → 1, EdgeLength +4.22, Sharpening 0.5217 → 0.7554. #15284 at x−0.0013: 1 → 2, Sharpening 0.5563 → 0.2875. With every fix in, x+0.0013 still moves G on 13,111 plausible designs (7,881 past 0.002; 32 play another tier) through Asymmetry and the edge alone.

SPEC invariants the reference must respect: §4.4 says 'enclosed parts leave D bit-identical while the kept set is unchanged' (SPEC.md:1049). A measure-rank reference taken from every part (vc, vg) would let a cleaned part reorder the measure, so the measure's reference must come from kept parts (vck, vgk). The verdict comes before any kept flag, and its locality claim is that a verdict 'depends only on the part and on what covers it' (Sampling.luau:25–37). A design reference there makes the order of twins (equal volume, one slot, tied y and |x|) depend on the design's reference: on the box (needs a protruding part) or on every Grip part (a hidden Grip part could steer it). No twin-decided verdict moved anywhere in the census, but the claim's wording would need care.
measurements: Setup: tools are in C:\Users\louis\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-louis-Documents-RANDOM-ROBLOX\93ae48b4-72b9-4dc1-aa5d-451af1abf9a0\scratchpad\shift-census\work: census.luau (in-process compare; gna = G with Asymmetry and EdgeLength held as built), dumpfull.luau with drift.py (as-built drift, Parity line hashes and digest), mirror.luau with msum.py, timing.luau (two trees alternating in one process), mkvar.py (variant trees in var\), csum.py, played.py, table.py, attrib.py, movers.py. The step-by-step log is NOTES.md in that folder.

Shift tags, 21: x±0.0013, x±0.037, x±0.3317, xL±, y±0.0013, y±0.037, y+0.3317, yL±, z±0.0013, z±0.037, zL±. L is each design's room in the hitbox that way less 0.001; the median room is ~0.15 for z and y− and 0.25–0.29 for x. y−0.3317 and z±0.3317 leave the hitbox for every design, so they were not run. Shifts are plain double addition, like a free drag. '>0.002' counts |ΔG| strictly greater than 0.002 (V1 counted ≥, so its 621 is my 575 on its slice). 'played' means the played tier changes, not tierRaw only.

Machine and speed: 12 logical / 6 cores; the user's Studio, Discord etc. ran throughout, plus another agent's 2 Lune processes at times. Load sampled every 5 s: 6–80 %, mostly 20–60 %. Tree census of the plausible set: 3 lanes, 3,322 s / 2,365 s / 2×2,356 s. Analyze.run costs about 20–25 ms per design here.

With Asymmetry and the edge included, G moves on 15,397 designs at x+0.0013 and on every design at x±0.037 and xL±; up to 26,538 played-tier changes at xL−, max 0.3774. V1's slice (22,261–33,389) reproduces V1 exactly: z−0.037 G on 2,081, max 0.0354 (#32977), 11 played; y+0.3317 357, 0.0363 (#32816), 2.

candidates: vz / vx (ranks by z alone / by x alone, both ranks; fixer 5m's czrank extended to the verdict's rank). Closes: every Z (or X) tier change from the reorder. On the movers, Z max 0.0472 → 0.0175 and X non-anchored max 0.0666 → 0.0009. Leaves: ownership, contact and rounding edges. As built: vz changes X01/X02's kept flags, so the fixtures digest moves; vx changes 1 line hash; generated bit for bit. Breaks: a mirror image across z = 0 (x = 0) reverses the order of every set of parts tied on volume and y, not just exact sign twins (theory, not measured). Cost: nil.

vc / vck / vg / vgk (both ranks keyed on |q(c − ref)| then q(c − ref), with q odd-quantised to RANK_Q = 1e-9 and cy unchanged).
- vc: ref = centre of every part's box.
- vck: the verdict uses every part's box, the measure the kept parts' box.
- vg: every Grip part's volume-weighted centre.
- vgk: the verdict uses every Grip part (V4's frame point, known before any verdict), the measure the kept Grip parts (the difficulty frame's point).
Closes: the rank mechanism, X and Z alike; vck on the movers equals vz on Z plus vx on X. Mirror: the reference is exactly mirror-odd and q is odd, so only exact twins about the design's own centre swap, as the tree's twins about z = 0 do. Measured for F/R: same tiers and max. As built: fixtures and generated bit for bit for all four; plausible G on 544 / 469 / 115 / 111 designs, max 0.0047, no tier. 75 of those come from quantising alone (vq0: trig ribBars whose |x| differ by 1e-17). Steering: vc and vg let a cleaned part move the measure's reference, against §4.4 'enclosed parts leave D bit-identical'; vck and vgk do not. The verdict's reference can be moved only by a part extending the box (vck) or by any Grip part (vgk), and only for twins. Cost: one pass over the parts per rank call; nil.

vo / vop (ownership box test margin −OVERLAP_TOL / +OVERLAP_TOL: touching parts never / always above). Closes: the face-contact flips of H; Y's G moves on the movers drop to 21 pairs at 0.0001 (vo) or 172 (vop, until vk2). As built:
- vop: fixtures and generated bit for bit; plausible G on 474, max 0.0354, 2 played tiers (grilles), because the tree dropped a touching Blade part by rounding.
- vo: C04 changes (digest moves); plausible G on 9,579, 29 played tiers.
vop matches GJK's tolerance (the code comment says 'GJK decides at this gap') and is the smaller drift. vo is more accurate: the grille's bars own 0.00729 against an exact 0.00762, where vop gives 0.00245. Cost: nil.

vk / vk2 / vt (sampled-overlap counts and tangency). vk: ceil(extent/h − 1e-9). vk2: vk plus 'extent ≤ 1e-9 has no cell' (a touching part's flat box). vt: OVERLAP_TOL 1e-9 → 1e-7, above GJK's ~4e-8 on round pairs. Closes: owned-volume moves (vk alone: X 6,461 → 335 pairs, Z 3,912 → 198), the flat-box Y moves under vop, #16913 and the cages. As built: fixtures and generated bit for bit; plausible vk2 moves G on 127 (max 0.0123), and vt adds 9 to R's drift. Breaks: Reference.spec's prototype check of refined cells (F1 676 → 0); the volumes are the same. Cost: nil.

va (Asymmetry's mirror-candidate box at reach + 1e-9) and vq9 (each factor's x rounded to 1e-9 inside G's sum; the stored terms keep x). Closes: the wrapRings Asymmetry moves (≤ 0.0037), and the 0.0001 steps where G's rounding was tipped by a factor's last bits. As built: fixtures and generated bit for bit; plausible vq9 moves 13 designs by 0.0001. Breaks: Factors.spec's unit-count check (F4 19,445 vs 19,264). Cost: nil.

vj (contact at CONTACT_TOL + 1e-9: V3's box test and GJK, the contact rows' box margin and d0 test). Closes: Joints under shifts (15,889 pairs → 0 on the movers), and makes connectivity robust at exact 0.01 gaps. As built: Joints changes on 11 fixtures (G the same), so T-DIF-12's calibration and regression goldens and the fixtures digest move and S-PAR-02 must be rerun; Joints changes on 8,608 plausible designs. Joints is unweighted in the MVP. Cost: nil.

vnyz / vnxyz (normalise the design before analysis: every part moved by −ref, ref from every part's box (z centre, lowest y; x centre too for vnxyz), independent of the verdict, positions moved back afterwards). vnyz closes most Z moves (9,114 → 2,272 pairs) but not the laminate tier changes (11 designs, 0.0472): rounding breaks their exact ties after normalising. It also leaves the ownership and contact edges (Y 1,323 pairs, 0.0085) and does nothing for X. As built: last bits on 108 fixtures and 190 generated designs, so both digests move; plausible G on 495 (max 0.0015). Cost ×0.918–1.069. vnxyz also re-centres Asymmetry and the raster on the box: G changes on 27 fixtures (7 tiers), which is a SPEC change. Not recommended.

R = vgk + vop + vk2 + vt + va + vq9 + vj (recommended), and R' = R without vj. Closes: every whole-design shift move on 33,389 + 136 + 200 designs and 21 shifts, beyond last-bit rounding: G does not move on any design along Y or Z, and along X only Asymmetry and the edge move, as the SPEC defines. Keeps: mirror readings as the tree's; cost within noise. Moves: as built, fixtures and generated bit for bit except Joints on 11 fixtures (vj only; R' keeps the digest and T-DIF-12); plausible G on 703 designs (max 0.0354, 2 played tiers on grilles).
